title: Terminal

new.title: Open a terminal
new.rootWarning: A root terminal can change anything on the server: every command runs with full privileges.

root.label: Allow root terminals
root.enableText: Administrators will be able to open terminals as root, with full control of the server. Turn this on only while you need it.
root.locked: The server's configuration does not allow root terminals, so they stay off.

close.title: Close {name}?
close.text: The shell ends, together with the programs it runs.

empty.title: No terminal is open
empty.text: Open a terminal to run commands on the server as a site owner or another user.

hint: Terminals keep running for 5 minutes after you leave this page; come back in time to pick them up again.
